description: Minimal differentiating features and the two Minimal subsystems: F7 Owner's weekly Hindi voice briefing (Req 22), F9 Fake-review-adjusted benchmarks (Req 23), F10 Proof of Impact (Req 24), F11 Complaint forecasting (Req 25), F13 Closed-loop review replies (Req 26), F14 Every-number-is-clickable Drilldown (Req 27), Guest Compass contextual-bandit recommender (Req 28), and Bhasha Concierge multilingual grounded assistant (Req 29). These are thin but must work end-to-end on the website.
steps: F14 Drilldown (Req 27) in app/services/common/drilldown.py + a reusable frontend <Drilldown> component: every displayed count/share/score/chart point links to the source Review_Records or Complaints behind it; the drilldown highlights each relevant Aspect_Mention evidence span; for count metrics the number of listed source records equals the clicked count (invariant, tested); each listed Review_Record shows its source URL (or 'source URL unavailable'). Build this early in the feature so other Minimal views reuse it, and retrofit existing Market Radar / Sentinel numbers to be clickable.

F10 Proof of Impact (Req 24) in app/services/market_radar/impact.py + website: a manager logs an Intervention (date, Aspect, description, Home_Property); once >=30 days of post-Intervention reviews exist, estimate a difference-in-differences effect on the Aspect score using the other Cluster Properties as control, with a 90% CI; the website shows pre/post trends for the Home_Property vs control plus the estimated effect; a parallel-trends warning when pre-period trends differ significantly (p<0.05).

F11 Complaint Forecasting (Req 25) in app/services/sentinel/forecast.py + website: a 4-week-ahead weekly forecast of negative Aspect_Mention counts per Aspect per Home_Property with an 80% prediction interval using seasonal components + recent Changepoints; raise an early warning naming the Aspect + forecast week when the forecast upper bound exceeds the trailing 12-week mean by >50%; show forecast accuracy (MAE) over the most recent 8 weeks of held-out data.

F9 Authenticity_Filter (Req 23) in app/services/market_radar/authenticity.py + website: flag reviews in a burst (daily count > 28-day rolling mean + 3 SD), near-duplicates (text cosine similarity >=0.9), and single-review authors where the platform exposes reviewer history; compute a 0..1 suspicion score from the flags; an 'adjusted view' recomputes Cluster rankings excluding reviews with suspicion >=0.7 and shows original vs adjusted ranks side by side; label flagged reviews 'suspicious signals' (not confirmed fake).

F13 Reply_Composer (Req 26) in app/services/market_radar/replies.py + website: draft a reply in the Review_Record's detected language; where a resolved Complaint or logged Intervention matches the review's negative Aspects, cite the logged fix; exclude guest PII, room numbers and internal staff names; require a manager/owner to approve or edit a draft before it is marked ready-to-post; state only facts present in Complaints/Interventions/Property_Facts; use the LLM adapter with the template fallback (labelled template-generated) when unreachable.

F7 Briefing_Generator (Req 22) in app/services/market_radar/briefing.py + website/WhatsApp mock: at the configured weekly schedule build a Hindi script covering rating change, top improving + top declining Aspect, new Changepoints, open P1/P2 complaint count, and one recommended action; convert to speech <=60s via a TTS adapter (stub/local, e.g. gTTS if reachable else a placeholder audio artifact) ; send audio + script text to opted-in owners via the WhatsApp mock; every number in the script comes from computed PahadPulse metrics, the LLM is used only for phrasing (template fallback otherwise).

Guest_Compass (Req 28) in app/services/guest_compass/ + /guest-compass page: recommend from rooms/food/activities/spa/local-experiences using Stay context; cold-start segment (stay purpose, party composition, season) with segment-level priors when no past-stay history; a contextual-bandit policy (LinUCB or Thompson sampling) updating from accept/decline; down-weight Aspects where the Home_Property's negative share exceeds the Cluster median (market signal from Market_Model); show up to 3 Recommendation_Cards (item, one-line reason, accept/decline) when a front-desk user opens a Stay; record outcome + any ancillary revenue entered; show uptake rate + ancillary revenue per guest per week; suppress upsell cards while the Stay has an open P1/P2 complaint.

Bhasha_Concierge (Req 29) in app/services/concierge/ + /concierge page: answer non-complaint WhatsApp questions in the guest's detected language, supporting at least Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil, French; ground every answer in retrieved Property_Facts (versioned) and log the fact ids used; confidence <0.7 or no fact above the relevance threshold -> hand off to front-desk + tell the guest staff will reply; a message classified as a complaint creates a Sentinel Complaint on channel concierge; show the share of queries resolved without staff per week; a Property_Fact update is reflected in answers within 5 minutes. Grounding/answer generation uses the LLM adapter with retrieval; template/extractive fallback offline.

Expose routers for impact, forecast, authenticity, replies, briefing, guest-compass, concierge and build/complete the themed website pages (/guest-compass, /concierge, plus impact/forecast/authenticity/replies panels on their relevant subsystem pages). Add pytest tests: Drilldown count invariant, DiD + parallel-trends warning, forecast early-warning threshold, authenticity flag + adjusted-rank, reply PII exclusion + fact-grounding, bandit accept/decline update + P1/P2 suppression, concierge handoff threshold + complaint routing + fact-freshness.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking any count/share/score/chart point opens a drilldown of the exact source records (count equals the clicked value for count metrics, tested), with highlighted evidence spans and source URLs.
Proof of Impact logs Interventions and, with >=30 days of post data, shows a DiD effect with 90% CI, pre/post vs control trends, and a parallel-trends warning when p<0.05.
Forecasting shows a 4-week weekly forecast per Aspect with an 80% interval, raises early warnings on the >50%-over-trailing-mean rule, and reports 8-week held-out MAE.

Authenticity_Filter flags burst/near-duplicate/single-review signals, computes a suspicion score, and the adjusted view re-ranks excluding >=0.7 reviews showing original vs adjusted, labelled 'suspicious signals'.

Reply_Composer drafts in the review's language, cites matching logged fixes, excludes PII/room numbers/staff names, requires manager/owner approval, and uses only facts from Complaints/Interventions/Property_Facts with an LLM template fallback.
The weekly Hindi briefing produces a <=60s audio + script with all required content, numbers sourced from computed metrics, delivered to opted-in owners via the WhatsApp mock.

Guest Compass shows up to 3 contextual recommendation cards with cold-start segments + a bandit policy that updates on accept/decline, down-weights weak Aspects, records revenue, reports uptake/revenue, and suppresses upsells during an open P1/P2 complaint.

Bhasha Concierge answers in the guest's language across the five required languages grounded in Property_Facts (logging fact ids), hands off below 0.7 confidence, creates a concierge-channel Complaint on complaint messages, reports queries-resolved-without-staff, and reflects fact updates within 5 minutes.
All these features are reachable and functional on the themed website.
verification: Run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` and confirm all Minimal-feature + subsystem unit tests (incl. the Drilldown count invariant) pass.
Run `cd frontend && npm run build && npm test` and confirm the guest-compass, concierge and the Minimal-feature panels build and render.
Exercise the Guest Compass accept/decline and the Concierge handoff paths via API and confirm state updates as specified.
